Package edu.cnu.mdi.item

Class EllipseItem

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.item.AItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.PathBasedItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.PolygonItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.EllipseItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFeedbackProvider, IDrawable, EventListener
public class EllipseItem extends PolygonItem
An ellipse item represented internally as a Path2D polygonal approximation.

Key invariants:

  • The ellipse center is the item's focus (world coordinates).
  • Width/height are stored as full extents in world units.
  • Selection handles are the four cardinal points of the ellipse in its rotated frame (top/right/bottom/left).

Resize correctness after rotation depends on using the same azimuth convention everywhere. In this codebase, azimuth behaves like a compass bearing: 0° = north (+y), 90° = east (+x), increasing clockwise. That convention is used by WorldGraphicsUtils.project(Point2D.Double, double, double, Point2D.Double).

  • Constructor Details

    • EllipseItem

      public EllipseItem(Layer layer, double w, double h, double azimuth, Point2D.Double center)
      Create an ellipse.
      Parameters:
      layer - the z layer this item is on.
      w - full width in world units (clamped to MIN_SIZE).
      h - full height in world units (clamped to MIN_SIZE).
      azimuth - rotation in degrees, using the application's compass/bearing convention.
      center - ellipse center in world coordinates (copied). If null, the ellipse path is null until focus is set and rebuildPath() is called.
